title: Agentflow bug record frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a Markdown issue record at the root of docs/issues/ (flat: docs/issues/ISS-<YYYY>-<NNN>-<slug>.md, where the slug is a Chinese or ASCII description; rejected records move to docs/issues/归档/<YYYY-MM-DD>/).

severity.description: Priority grade: P0 = critical (data loss, security, release blocker), P1 = high, P2 = medium, P3 = low.

provenance.description: Where the flawed behavior or artifact came from — the field that decides whether this record is Agentflow evidence. agentflow: Agentflow's own surface (a clause, role, gate, evaluation, brief discipline, or tool under tools/lab/). session-artifact: produced ad hoc inside the session and covered by no Agentflow clause (the agent's own plan, analysis, decision, or code). user-input: supplied by the user. external: pre-existing product code, host, tool, or environment. undetermined: not yet established — the record must name the missing evidence and resolve it before the improvement loop consumes the record. NOTE: this is a string enum on issue records; the episode record's same-named provenance field (skills/improve/references/episode.schema.json) is a different field — an object holding the evidence carrier and its sanitization flag. They are not interchangeable and neither is derived from the other.

class_id.description: Failure class this record belongs to; the recurrence ledger lives at docs/issues/recurrence/<class_id>.md.

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of the class this record is (1 = first). A digit string: Markdown frontmatter values are strings, not YAML numbers.

closure_criteria.description: Measurable condition that must hold before the bug counts as closed: a named metric, log absence, or check output. Required for verified; 'works as expected' is not a criterion.

fix_revision.description: Commit, PR, or release where the fix landed (repo-qualified when the fix is in another repository).
